restoration_note: Teaching 68 develops the two-fold sun-typology: the Lord's illumining wisdom rising into the natural mind (first contest, scattering the self's storehouses and dwellings, undoing the body of the Five Sons of Darkness) and the Lord's illumining wisdom setting (the consummation, last Extraction ascending to the Aeon of Light, while Death and the deniers go into the sunless place). Most gaps are tightly constrained: short morphological completions (genitive ⲉ, suffix ϩ on ⲡⲕⲁϩ, ⲓ in ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ, ⲟⲩ in ⲛⲟⲩ); standard Lyc. Coptic phrases (ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄, ϩⲛ̄ ⲟⲩ-, ⲍⲙ̄ for ϩⲙ̄, conjunctive ⲛϥ-); and fixed Manichaean cosmological vocabulary (ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉⲧϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ "outer body," ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ "Aeon of Light," ⲁⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ "deniers," ⲧⲙⲡⲣⲉ "sunless place"). Gap {1} is the only weakly constrained one — editor preserves only ⲡⲉ as article-fragment of an "until the [time]" phrase; restored conservatively. Editor proposals confirmed throughout, with the spiritual reading (rising = first contest, setting = consummation/Last Extraction) anchoring the cosmological vocabulary.

coptic_restorations.basis: Editor proposal confirmed: standard Lyc. conjunctive prefix ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄- 'and you may (know)', completing ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄ⲙ̄ⲙⲉ. Opens the chapter as exhortation to the disciples.

Editor preserves only ⲡⲉ — article-fragment of an 'until the [time/hour]' phrase (ϣⲁ-ⲡⲉ-...). Spiritual context confirms: the sun's shining lasts until a particular time before creatures emerge. Conservative minimal fill respecting the trace.
Editor proposal confirmed: ϩⲛ̄ ⲫⲓⲛⲏⲃ 'out of the sleep' (ⲫⲓⲛⲏⲃ = ⲡ-ⲉⲛⲏⲃ). Creatures emerging from sleep at sunrise — natural-plane image for the self's recoiling at the Radiance.
Editor proposal confirmed: Lyc. conjunctive ⲛϥ-ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄ 'and (the sun) shall be manifested,' parallel to preceding ⲛⲁⲡⲣ̄ⲓⲉ. Completes ⲛⲩ̄ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲛ̄ⲧ[ⲉ] genitive linker, completing the construction with ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲣⲱⲙⲉ on the next line.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲡⲕⲁ[ϩ] 'the earth,' required as referent of ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲁ- 'come forth onto.' Lexicon: ⲡⲕⲁϩ = the natural mind as ground.
Editor proposal confirmed: ϩ[ⲛ̄ ⲟⲩ]ⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧⲩ̄ 'in stillness' — standard idiomatic prepositional construction. Lexicon: ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓⲧϥ = the interior calm by which the rational receives.
Editor proposal confirmed: standard genitive linker ⲙ̄ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ̄ [ⲛ̄]ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'of the First Man.' Lexicon: ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ = the Lord as Divine Human.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛ̄[ⲧ]ⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'from the Greatness' — standard Manichaean cosmological term ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ for the Father of Greatness's proper register.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲛ[ⲟⲩ] = ⲛ̄ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ 'in (the) hour,' completing the time-marker that continues ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that' on the next line.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲁⲙ[ⲓ]ⲟⲛ 'their storehouses.' Lexicon: ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛ = states of the natural mind preserved (here in negative sense, the self's storehouses).
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲏ[ⲃ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲩ] 'their cave(rn) behind them' — ⲃⲏⲃ as 'cave/hole,' parallel to ⲙⲁⲛϩⲱⲡ 'hiding-place' earlier. The self's strongholds left behind at the first contest.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉⲧ[ϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ] 'the outer body' — fixed Manichaean cosmological term for the external archonic body. Lexicon ϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ = the outer/exterior degree.

Editor proposal confirmed: ⲡⲉ[ⲩⲥⲱⲙⲁ ϩⲙ ⲡ-ϣⲁⲣⲡ̄ ⲛ̄ⲁⲅⲱⲛ] 'their body in the first contest' — connecting the destruction of the outer body to the Five Sons mounted upon it, completing into ϣⲁⲣⲡ̄ ⲛ̄ⲁⲅⲱⲛ on next line.
Editor proposal confirmed: standard Lyc. relative converter ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ introducing the relative clause about the sun being chosen out of the cosmos with the chosen ones.
Editor restored final letter ϩ in ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ[ϩ]. Lyc. ⲍⲏⲧϩ = Sah. ϩⲏⲧϥ̄, 3sg.m. suffix-bearing form: 'of his heart.' The chosen ones of his (the Lord's/sun's) heart, of all men.
Editor proposal confirmed: Lyc. ⲍⲙ̄ = Sah. ϩⲙ̄ 'in,' connecting to ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ on next line: 'purified and refined in the cosmos.'

Editor proposal confirmed: ⲁⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄[ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ] 'to the Aeon of Light' — connecting to ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ on next line. Lexicon: ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲛⲃⲣ̄ⲣⲉ / Aeon of Light = the state of the regenerated rational at consummation; the destination of the last Extraction.

Editor proposal confirmed: ⲧⲙ̄- (privative) + ⲡⲣⲉ/ⲡⲣⲏ ('sun') = 'the sunless [place].' Fits the parallel with ⲡⲙⲁⲛ̄ⲱⲡⲧ ('place of judgment'), ⲧⲟⲩⲱⲏ ⲛ̄ⲕⲉⲕⲉ ('night of darkness'), and the chapter's sun-typology: where the Enemy/Death goes is precisely where the sun does not shine.

Editor proposal confirmed: Greek loanword ἀρνητής 'denier, repudiator,' standard Manichaean polemical term, paired with ⲣⲉϩⲭⲓⲟⲩⲁ 'blasphemers' on next line. Both denote the souls that have loved the darkness.
Editor proposal confirmed: ⲁⲭⲱⲩ = Lyc. ⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ 'upon them' (ⲭ for ϫ); idiom ϣⲱⲡⲉ + ⲉϫⲱ⸗ = 'happen upon, befall.' The state of the night-of-darkness befalling the deniers.

english_restorations.basis: ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄- as conjunctive prefix introducing the disciples' knowing — 'and you may know'.
Coptic restoration is only the article-fragment ⲡⲉ; spiritual context (the sun shining 'until' a fixed time) suggests 'the hour/time' as the most natural English. Tentative.
Coptic ⲫⲓⲛⲏⲃ = 'the sleep'; creatures of flesh emerging from sleep at sunrise — natural-plane figure for the self's recoiling before the Radiance.
Coptic conjunctive ⲛϥ- attached to ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄: 'and (he) shall be manifested,' parallel to preceding 'shall shine.'
Coptic ⲡⲕⲁϩ — the natural mind as ground onto which all creatures emerge at the Lord's rising.
Coptic ⲃⲏⲃ ⲛ̄ⲥⲱⲩ — the self's caverns abandoned at the first contest, parallel to the storehouses and dwellings just named.
Coptic ϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ 'outer' — the outer body of the self, the external archonic body destroyed at the first contest.
Coptic ⲡⲉⲩⲥⲱⲙⲁ ϩⲙ ⲡ- — 'their body in the (first contest),' connecting the Five Sons-of-Darkness's vehicle to the contest narrative on the following line.
Coptic relative converter ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲉ introducing the relative clause about the sun's choosing-out at sunset.
Coptic ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧϩ (Lyc. for ϩⲏⲧϥ̄) — the chosen ones of his heart, the Lord's intimate election from among all humanity.
Coptic ⲍⲙ̄ = ϩⲙ̄ 'in,' connecting purification-and-refining to ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ on the next line.
Coptic ⲁⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲙ̄- — the last Extraction's destination, the Aeon of Light (lexicon: ⲡⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲛⲃⲣ̄ⲣⲉ, the state of the regenerated rational at consummation).
Coptic ⲧⲙⲡⲣⲉ — the sunless place where Death and the deniers are gathered, the dark complement to the sun's rising in the chapter's typology.
Coptic ⲁⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ (Greek ἀρνητής) — those who have repudiated the Lord, paired with the blasphemers on the next line.
Coptic ⲁⲭⲱⲩ = ⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ 'upon them,' the 3pl. object of the idiom ϣⲱⲡⲉ ⲉϫⲱ⸗ 'befall' — the night-of-darkness befalling the deniers.
